def my_find(s: str, sub: str, start: int) -> int:
    return s.find(sub, start)

def process(s: str, last: int) -> str:
    i = my_find(s, "dot", max(last, 1))
    if i == -1 or i >= len(s) - 3:
        return s[last:]
    return s[last:i] + "." + process(s, i + 3)

def main() -> None:
    s = input().strip()
    atPos = my_find(s, "at", 1)
    s2 = s[:atPos] + '@' + s[atPos + 2:]
    ans = process(s2, 0)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
